whenToUse: Actions that wait for a response, such as saving or paying.
The same request must not be sent twice.
You want to show the result right by the button.
whenNotToUse: Work that takes more than a few seconds (use a progress toast).
The result changes the whole screen (report it on the new screen).
Light actions that needn't wait for a response (use an optimistic update).

alternatives.name: Optimistic UI
alternatives.reason: When the result can be shown first.

accessibility: While working, use aria-disabled and aria-busy instead of disabled so focus stays on the button.
Announce the status (Saving, Saved) with role="status".
Change the state in words along with the icon, not color alone.
Set a minimum width so the button doesn't resize when its state changes.
